description: Baseline: JSONDecoder + FlexibleString + compactMap mapping for 5000 streams
Compare three approaches: A=FlexibleString (current), B=direct flex decode helpers, C=decode-to-final-struct. B is fastest.

asi.hypothesis: Eliminating FlexibleString struct overhead should speed up decoding
asi.discovery: Approach B (direct KeyedDecodingContainer helpers) is 16% faster than current FlexibleString approach
